items.title: Bensouda Warns IEC Against Political Interference, Accuses Barrow of Trying to Block His Candidacy
items.summary: By Fatou Sillah Talib Ahmed Bensouda, leader of the UNITE Party and presidential candidate of Coalition 2026, has called on the Independent Electoral Commission (IEC) to safeguard its independence and resist political interference ahead of The Gambia’s December 5 presidential ...
items.author: Fatou Sillah
